record.summary: Amendment of Lithuania's Law on Technology and Innovation that adds Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 to the law's annex of implemented EU acts and makes the AI Act's definitions apply to the law's other terms. The institution the Government authorises to implement technology and innovation policy is to act as national competent authority and notifying authority under Articles 28(1) and 70(1) of the AI Act from 2 August 2025, and to set up and supervise a limited AI regulatory sandbox under Article 57(1) from 1 January 2026, both under procedures set by the Minister of Economy and Innovation. It sets no penalties and names no market surveillance authority.
record.notes: Adopted by the Seimas on 14 January 2025, signed by President Gitanas Nausėda and published in the Register of Legal Acts (TAR) on 22 January 2025. In force from 1 April 2025; Article 9(4) and (5), which set deadlines for implementing acts, from 23 January 2025; the notifying-authority provision (Article 5(4)) from 2 August 2025; and the sandbox provision (Article 5(5)) from 1 January 2026. The Government and the Minister of Economy and Innovation had to adopt the implementing acts by 31 March 2025, those for the notifying-authority provision by 1 August 2025 and those for the sandbox by 31 December 2025. The law also changes the Law on Technology and Innovation's rules on state support for innovative businesses, experimental development, science and technology parks and national programmes.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the e-seimas record page and the e-seimas text of Law XV-105 (both stored 12 Oct 2026). They confirm the title, number, adoption on 14 January 2025, publication in TAR on 22 January 2025 (No. 715), the staggered entry into force, the notifying-authority and sandbox provisions, the annex and that the law has no amendments or consolidated versions. date_last_updated was 1 January 2026, the commencement of the sandbox provision; a partial commencement is not a new version, so it moved to the notes and the field is empty. The identification of the authorised institution as the Innovation Agency, the content of the companion law XV-106, the Commission's list of single points of contact and the 2026 government draft implementing law rested on regulations.ai or on pages that were not stored, and were removed; the Ministry of the Economy and Innovation's English news item on the adoption, requested to name the authorised institution, could not be stored (eimin.lrv.lt answered HTTP 403). No English version of the law was found.

judgment.status_reasoning: Article 9: the law is in force from 1 April 2025, Article 9(4)-(5) from 23 January 2025, Article 5(4) from 2 August 2025 and Article 5(5) from 1 January 2026. All these dates are before today (17 October 2026), and e-seimas marks the act 'Galioja' (valid) with no amendments. 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI Act implementing amendment that designates the national competent and notifying authority and the AI regulatory sandbox; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the adoption on 14 January 2025; date_in_force the general commencement on 1 April 2025; the later commencements are in the notes.
